segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some in their 50s and 60s, report the oil absorbs without adding shine and does not make their skin look greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or dehydrated skin, including post-menopausal and lifelong-dry skin, report the oil provides lasting hydration and softness without feeling greasy.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report using it selectively (avoiding the t-zone or using fewer drops) to avoid an oily look while still getting hydration on drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or highly reactive skin report no irritation and good tolerance, with one noting it is soothing.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin report it keeps their face supple through the day without feeling oily.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature, aging, or peri/post-menopausal skin report improved smoothness, glow, and softer look of lines, with one describing softened wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Multiple mature-skin reviewers report smoother, softer skin and some softening of fine lines and wrinkles around the mouth and neck; one describes wrinkles being 'stopped in their tracks' while another notes only 'some softening' rather than removal.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, especially those with dry or lifelong-dry skin, report significant, lasting hydration and a plumper, less flaky feel; effects are described as immediate and cumulative over weeks.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report reduced redness or fading discoloration, but this is not a common theme and one combination-skin reviewer using it regularly reports no change in redness.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer using tretinoin and Spironolactone reports the oil supports hydration needs from these treatments; another with highly reactive skin reports zero reactions.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her skin tone looking more even with no new breakouts; not widely discussed otherwise.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including one acne-prone at 45 and one post-menopausal reviewer, report no breakouts or new blemishes from use; dissent is minimal but one 3-star reviewer stopped repurchasing without citing blemish issues specifically.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the oil does not increase shine and absorbs rather than sitting on the skin, though one combination-skin reviewer notes using more than a few drops can look oily on her small face.

extraits.titre: Fan for life of this oil!
extraits.texte: Beautiful oil to use day or night and has immediately become one of my favorite RMS products overnight! I've used many expensive clean lines from Ogee to Tata Harper to Pai and this is one of my favorite oils ever! It's light and soaks right in immediately. I have dry skin for reference. I use it day and night under a serum or moisturizer. A little goes a long way just a few drops needed!

This is a miracle product for me! When I turned 50, my skin changed (all you peri- menopause ladies know what I'm talking about!) and natural products I had used for years no longer worked since my skin was suddenly dry, flaking, and dull. I found RMS and started using several products including the Kakudu oil. All I can say is THANK YOU, Rose-Marie! I get zero reactions (highly reactive skin), my face is much less dry and makeup doesn't cake and settle as much. I recently took a new executive head shot and there is no retouching of any kind. RMS makeup and skin care made me look glowing!

It is hard for me to pick a favorite RMS product, but the Kakadu Oil is absolutely one of them. I have using the oil for less than a year and I can not tell you the difference it's made in my skin. I struggle with dryness and combinations skin, but the Kakadu Oil helps me manage both by moisturizing and not being so oily that everything slides off. It does not take much to make a difference in the texture and/or smoothness of face and neck, etc. I use it faithfully and recommend the same.

Feels amazing on the skin. You don't need a lot. All the texture on my face has all but disappeared. I'm 63 and still have oily skin. This product works miracles. In a few short weeks, my lines are less deep, less noticeable and skin more refined. Works well on your neck as well. Thank you :relaxed:ï¸ so so much! Mary.

I use the Kakadu Beauty Oil every night and wake up with soft, well nourished skin- for someone with very dry, mature, sensitive skin that's impressive! I also mix a drop in with my foundation (or under sunscreen in the morning) for a healthy glow.
i've always been hesitant to try an oil on my face- combination skin- but this has been wonderful. skin is softer, and even better red discoloration is fading. High recommendation!
